notes.title: It's the Chinese New Year! Bug fixes and bug fixes for all!
notes.notes:
Hello my favorite humans and human like things out there!

It is the Chinese New Year! Everyone get excited for a new year of liiiiife!

For Yolk Heroes, we're hard at work on our first major content update. Poke Place.

Poke Place is a Virtual Pet Game within the Virtual Pet Game, so your Virtual Pet can have Virtual Pets. You know you've always wanted this! Poke place is pronounced to rhyme with yolk. Poke being slang for little buddy and all that. It won't have any plot importance, but it will have the importance of getting to raise a little fairy thing! Also, some of the best pixel art we did for the project but ended up being cut from the main game is being re-used to give it some real pizzazz! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117109/3f6cb99261a171251433a0f1443dfa66006c50d1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117109/d91e84735bcdad4ce513c65909cec36b1220d3e0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117109/1be3ea7c5aeee1165cd3eb20f702fa6b93b2fd3f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117109/d0b239290b03d16ff972c8f24c0389949a766887.png[/img]

We're hoping to release this update to steam and mobile a little later this year, however, the lead developer on it also has a full time job NOT working on cute games like this, so it's a bit slow going! Bills are hard!

That said, we've also got a new build up. It should fix a few issues here and there. So, here's the change list for this build of the game.

-Removed an enemy from the compendium that never actually appears in the game. (Was a Boss that had two names. Whoops!)
-Added several enemies to the game that were in the compendium but could not actually be encountered. (Oh no! I'm so sorry 100% completionists!!)
-Fixed several bugs in the mobile version such as the tragic store crash. (Not important to you PC version peeps, but hopefully the mobile experience is much smoother and less crashy now.)
-Added more pixie dust to the Fairy Queen's magic, which is like fairy dust but made of pixels.
-Minor optimization changes. (Let me know if these cause the game to crash in weird ways)
-Fixed a bug that caused the game to get stuck upon certain actions. Now it doesn't!
-Gave my trust to the future

Those are the changes! We're hoping to have the mobile version updated so you can pay to get a version without ads very soon, but it turns out this doesn't seem to ever have been done before in Godot, so we're fighting with the very engine the game is built in. YAAAAY! Yaay...

Anyways, love you all.

-Always

The Yolk Heroes Team

notes.title: A game I wrote, Fartmania, is having a Highscores Contest right now!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow humans!

Some very amazing friends of mine asked me to help them make a game a few months ago, and I being a fool said yes. I helped write the script and dialogue for FART MANIA! A fun little vertical platformer that involves you fighting aliens with farts.

I'm not actually a big fan of fart jokes, but I am a big fan of my friends. The game came out really good, honestly, and now they're having a contest where you can be a character in the game. What follows is their fun little add! You should take a look.

Enjoy!!!

*******

[previewyoutube=eoMhKcsULT0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey you, yes I am talking to you! I have to ask you, have you ever been to a rizz party with looksmaxing and edge.... Jesus Christ, who wrote that script? Never mind. The thing is, [b]Fartmania is about to be released, and YOU can become its character![/b] You can become a.. princess... or... a war veteran... or even… Drake. How? You won't believe it, but it's so, so easy. All you have to do is [b]find Fartmania on Steam[/b] and [b]download the demo version[/b], which is, of course, [b]free[/b]! In order to become one of the characters possible to meet on the map, [b]you need to achieve the highest possible score and stay at the top of the highscores for two weeks.[/b] And that's it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936966/691b5c3d8b1c6716843158d8d706d17e276f7e22.gif[/img]

The winner will be contacted after Steam Fest and we'll make your piggy character come to life! Just remember that...well.... We will not give it a square mustache or an obscene object in its hand.... [b]But other than that, anything is possible![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936966/668c448821fb87925cf6351150363e5a30a80772.gif[/img]

[b]If I could give you any advice, I would definitely say - keep trying.[/b] Again and again, look for the best routes on your character, analyze which pigs are best to collect first, or maybe which ones are better to avoid completely, so you don't risk bumping into spikes and losing many precious seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936966/fe259442b22bcdf2afe7507d465d620a49a5f744.gif[/img]

I'll also tell you a secret, but don't tell anyone. Well, during boss fights, if you are fast enough, you can press the spacebar twice to deal damage to the boss twice. [b]But... whatever, I didn't tell you anything![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936966/be2bae62810e0e4e505faad69c5a5d07ff7fa877.gif[/img]

You can also add your runs on social media with [b]#fartmaniacontest[/b] and [b]#fartmania[/b], gather your friends to play and together fight for the first place in the ranking!

So don't wait, just download the demo, buy the game and.... Fart to the top!

[b]Download the demo here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041970/Tales_From_The_Arcade_Fartmania_Demo/

notes.title: Finally an update! (Fixed that annoying offline bug!)
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Yolklings!

It's been a minute, almost a full month since our last update! We've been very hard at work on the game believe it or not. Trying to address the most complained about issues and bugs. 

We've also been hard at work on the mobile port of the game. Which we're hoping will come out next month, but don't hold us to that! Mobile porting is hard.

Most exciting for this update is that we've hopefully figured out the issue with the Auto Queue so that it can work during offline progress and let people play the game a bit more idle friendly if they like to turn the game off for extended periods of time and come back to find the Yolk having done many glorious things.

We also adjusted a lot of numbers to try and make the end game smoother as well as many small quality of life and other bug issues.

    v1.1.0f -------
        -Auto Queue can now activate during offline progress. Fixed many offline progress related bugs.
        -Monster reward money and xp are now fixed. Numbers were swapped before.
        -Updated weapon multipliers.
        -Various other bug fixes and QOL improvements.
        -Updated Japanese localization. (Let us know if there are any issues)
        -Fixed a bug where if auto queue activated during the transition of an action completing, the Hero    
        might stand around during the next action not doing anything.
        -The Fairy Queen weeps for you.
        -Auto Queue no longer complains about 'not enough energy' and instead silently does nothing in  
        such cases.
        -Fix a bug where a quest's unlocks would unlock before the quest was completed.

notes.title: Yolk Hereos 1.1 It's a sweet Indie Bundle thing!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117109/70535c04c65d37b97f65b8303d80b2e1eff4fbc9.png[/img]

Greetings fellow mortals out there in mortal land! (I too am mortal)

In celebration of Yolk Heroes hitting 1.1 we're doing a big coll bundle thing. And you know, It's the summer sale and with it silly gimmicks to try and get your attention. I am no different. My silly gimmick was to hit up all my indie game friends and bully as many of them as I could into setting up a sweet bundle!

It's called the "Games You've Seen Around but Never Got Around to Playing!!" bundle. It has eight pretty neato games in it. Don't feel like you have to buy the whole bundle if you don't want to, but you should take a look at all the games in it. They're pretty neato! Some of the best games of all time, honestly.

We’ve got Dino Run DX which is just an amazing game where you get to run from the apocalypse as a dinosaur. Russian Subway Dogs where you do, in fact, get to play as a Russian subway dog (I mean, you do want to be a dog, right?). The Eternal Castle, which is probably the best cinematic platformer ever made. Brave's Rage which is one of those roguelite deckbuilding games but with an ATB gauge for active tension and danger. Poker Quest which is another roguelite game, this time where you use a standard deck of playing cards for some RPG adventure shenanigans. Error 143, a rather bawdy romantic visual novel about hacking and falling in love with a jerk. Also, of course, Yolk Heroes! Which is, you know, a game!

Tell your friends and enemies about this slick and beautiful Summer Sale Bundle. It's only offered for a limited time!

Also, as always, thanks to everyone who has supported me so far. Consider doing the same to these other talented creators.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update! Lots of fixes and things!
notes.notes:
Greetings Guardian Spirits!

Big update today, as we move from 1.0 to the hopefully stable 1.1 build. There's been a lot of little tweaks to stop bugs and hopefully make things less lame!

Big things though include...

AutoHeal option. You can set it so you will automatically use healing items. Commonly requested and now commonly allowed!

Yolk retirement and continuation - You can now choose to retire your Yolk (And visit them by traveling back to the previous chapter where they will join you as a companion on quests you don't already have a companion) or moving your Yolk forward to the next chapter but restarting its level to 1. So, those that were afraid of losing Yolks, that should no longer be an issue.

We have a cool Compendium now! Full of lots of info and interesting text! You should check that out.

Hopefully a few quality of life improvements as well.

There might be bugs caused by the changes, we tried to test it as much as we could on our side but please do let us know!

Also, sadly, any Yolks lost thanks to saves being over-written, or having moved on to the next chapter without going back to the previous one. To help people cope with this terrible loss we are creating a memorial to the lost Yolks. If you wish to have your lost Yolk immortalized in the compendium, please send info about their name, what they were doing when they were accidentally lost from this world. Send the yolk info to contact@14hoursproductions.com

Updates will hopefully be coming a bit slower after this. While there are a few features we wanted to get in for 1.1 we didn't, the next major update will probably not be for a month or so. However we will continue to try and to fix bugs and more minor issues as well as take suggestions from the community.

Love you all!

-Always the Yolk Heroes Team

notes.title: Chapter advancement without warning fixed!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Guardian Spirits,

We have fixed the bug that was causing some people to be unceremoniously catapulted forward into a new chapter, alone, afraid, and without hope. Confused as to what had happened. You now will be given the choice when (or even if) you advance to the next chapter and begin raising a new Yolk.

I understand the tragedy that many of you have lost a precious child and loved one. However, know, that even if it seems that way, they were victorious in their quest. They only retired because there was no more evil to fight and thanks to their efforts, the area they now live in knows peace and justice.

Some have wondered why they must give up their current Elf and raise a new one to experience the next chapters. Wishing they could keep the same heroic Egg Born the whole time. While I understand the desire for that, the truth is that Yolk Heroes is meant to be in many ways about what it means to be a parent. The joys and tribulations that comes with the raising of someone... and the pain of eventually having to let go like all good parents must.

That said, feel free to just play forever in whatever chapter you want now and never face the harsh reality of the future. The choice is yours! Yolk Heroes is at the end of the day meant to be a toy for you to enjoy in the way you find most fun. I don't judge Elf Parents or how they choose to raise their Yolk in the privacy of their own game.

Thank you all so much for the support you've given this silly little game over the last week.

notes.title: Yolk Heroes is Cracking Out On Steam!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow humans.

I've been working hard on Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago for about two years now.

It was supposed to take 8 months.

We're going to be releasing in Japan and China which I've always wanted to do. You have no idea how much I want to be 'Big In Japan!' I would KILL to be Big in Japan. This game was obviously inspired a lot by Dragon Quest and it oozes in every pixel of the game. The early virtual pet games, the one where you were looking after a dinosaur and it looked like a little green egg, and all those dumb games like Cookie Clicker and Progress Quest.

The game is meant to be a toy. A companion game. Something for you to enjoy and have and own. It has no micro transactions and it isn't very expensive. It's meant to be a Virtual Pet Game, a JRPG, and an Idle Game. It's also meant to be something kind of new. You know, a new thing that I invented (By stealing ideas from everyone else).

When I say *I* have been working hard on Yolk Heroes for two years, I mean a team of people who have been nice enough to trust that the things I ask them to do is working to some kind of cohesive whole. Today is the day I wonder if I've done a good job as a leader. However, without a doubt, my entire team has been amazing. Everyone who has worked on this game went above and beyond.  I only hope the final product does their individual work even a little bit of justice.

There are a lot of features and balance fixes I want to do, and there will be a lot of bugs found by players (I'm sure) right off the bat. The team will be trying to respond to any player input, especially in this first week. 

Thank you for trusting us enough to try out our little indie game.

Hope you have fun.

-Always

The Yolk Heroes Team

notes.title: Yolk Heroes Delayed?! Noooooooo! (But... yes.)
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow humans,

I am sorry to say that Yolk Heroes will need to be delayed one last time. The balance and the quality of the moment to moment gameplay isn't where the team wants it to be and we are VERY sick of people releasing buggy games. We are doing our best to make sure that Yolk Heroes is a game that at least most people will be able to play without having to smack their computer and scream at the gods.

We're also adding in a few cute features with the extra time like a compendium that keeps track of the fun and goofy monsters you've run into.

This means that sadly, instead of today, the release date of Yolk Heroes will be on may 20th. We apologize greatly to anyone that was really looking forward to the game, but I promise it'll be here! Just a little later next month instead of today.

If you run into me (Matthew Ritter) in person, I will give you one apology hug and buy you a pizza if you mention to me how sad this has made you.

That said, the team is working tirelessly to bring to you the greatest Egg-Baby Based JRPG+IDLE Adventure that has ever graced this world. I hope that you'll be excited to join us for the full release next month.

Thank you for your patience and your ongoing interest in this silly little game.

-Always

Matthew Ritter (And the whole Yolk Heroes team)
